definitions.full: H7513. raphsodah [ רפְסֹדָה ] noun [feminine] raft (etymology dubious; Late Hebrew once רַפְסוּרוֺת bench or stool on which feet rest); — plural רַפְסֹדוֺת 2Chr 2:16 (late || for דֹּבְרוֺת 1 Kings 5:23).
